problem_text:
A logistics company must coordinate 10 delivery trucks to complete 10 distinct routes.  

Each route consists of a series of checkpoint stops represented as pairs (Truck, Service time),  
where each pair specifies the truck assigned to handle that checkpoint and the time needed to complete the service.  
The sequence of pairs indicates the strict order in which the checkpoints must be visited.  

Route details:  
* R1 follows the sequence: (T8, 4) → (T3, 9) → (T2, 5) → (T6, 7) → (T1, 5) → (T10, 8) → (T9, 8) → (T7, 10) → (T4, 10) → (T5, 7)  
* R2 follows the sequence: (T4, 9) → (T10, 7) → (T1, 7) → (T6, 9) → (T2, 6) → (T3, 4) → (T7, 3) → (T9, 5) → (T8, 2) → (T5, 3)  
* R3 follows the sequence: (T1, 3) → (T6, 7) → (T10, 10) → (T2, 5) → (T9, 1) → (T8, 8) → (T5, 2) → (T4, 4) → (T3, 10) → (T7, 10)  
* R4 follows the sequence: (T9, 5) → (T10, 10) → (T1, 10) → (T7, 3) → (T2, 9) → (T6, 10) → (T8, 7) → (T3, 6) → (T5, 2) → (T4, 3)  
* R5 follows the sequence: (T2, 5) → (T9, 5) → (T3, 8) → (T4, 8) → (T10, 4) → (T1, 5) → (T5, 10) → (T6, 9) → (T7, 7) → (T8, 8)  
* R6 follows the sequence: (T5, 2) → (T8, 6) → (T4, 10) → (T10, 4) → (T7, 1) → (T9, 9) → (T1, 2) → (T2, 1) → (T3, 7) → (T6, 6)  
* R7 follows the sequence: (T4, 7) → (T10, 10) → (T6, 5) → (T9, 7) → (T1, 10) → (T8, 3) → (T7, 3) → (T2, 1) → (T3, 2) → (T5, 3)  
* R8 follows the sequence: (T1, 9) → (T6, 7) → (T9, 8) → (T5, 10) → (T4, 10) → (T8, 7) → (T2, 10) → (T7, 5) → (T10, 10) → (T3, 10)  
* R9 follows the sequence: (T2, 5) → (T3, 7) → (T5, 5) → (T10, 7) → (T6, 10) → (T8, 1) → (T4, 8) → (T7, 4) → (T1, 9) → (T9, 5)  
* R10 follows the sequence: (T4, 6) → (T1, 1) → (T5, 1) → (T9, 2) → (T10, 10) → (T3, 9) → (T6, 7) → (T2, 2) → (T8, 7) → (T7, 6)  

Each checkpoint service must run continuously once it begins and cannot be interrupted,  
and each truck can only handle one checkpoint at a time.  
The goal is to schedule the service order of all checkpoints across the trucks  
so that the total completion time for all routes is minimized.
